_readme: Reviewed list of KNOWN upstream publisher outages that the smoke test reports as KNOWN OUTAGE instead of FAIL. path = example path or a prefix of it. Dates YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). An entry covers at most 14 days from since and stops counting after expires, so it cannot hide a problem for ever. Remove an entry as soon as the publisher recovers.

outages.reason: Taipower service.taipower.com.tw times out for cloud servers (GitHub probe rep-tp1 28 Nov: connect timeout after 120 s; workspace also times out); no library copy exists because the file is a static tariff with no harvest, and a copy could not be filled while the host blocks cloud IPs
CSB data.stat.gov.lv times out for cloud servers (GitHub harvest 26 Nov and probe rep-lv1: connect timeout; workspace: connection reset); no library copy until one collection succeeds
ANEEL dadosabertos.aneel.gov.br resets/times out connections from cloud servers (Vercel and GitHub; our copy of 11 Nov passed its 7 days on 18 Nov; probe from workspace 19 Nov: connection reset)
